payload.name: Failure mode in I-1795493412-ledger-temp-worktree-cleanup/P-1795493432-CLA-CF5.2/E-1795505480-CLA-CF5.2/_
payload.description: Reproduced failure across 4 executions with identical context.
payload.action: Review Loop iteration 2 finding detected: FIND-R2-002-01
symptoms: The sweep recognises a killed `git worktree add` by the literal `locked initializing`, but git writes that reason through gettext, so under a non-English git locale the leftover is skipped forever; make the match locale-independent (pin `LC_ALL=C` on the add or let a claimable owner lock override git's lock) and cover it with a test.
